value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco there yet. The first one is slated to open later in 2027. The closest open ones I found are in Burlington at 1225 Brant St, and the Laird Rd warehouse in Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd, which one site says also serves Oakville. I didn't find drive times, so I can't say which is closer for you.
